evidence.why: Complete input producer and animation consumer.

facts.rationale: Replaces the superseded input.x668 field reference with the current canonical pressed_buttons field while preserving the exact mask and producer-consumer behavior.
facts.value: Receives the fighter GObj, resolves its Fighter, reads input.pressed_buttons with mask 512 (0x200), and conditionally writes 1 to mv.dk.speciallw.x0. It does not clear the latch when the mask is absent. At animation exhaustion, ftDk_SpecialLwLoop_Anim consumes and clears a set latch before restarting the loop; an unset latch selects the End0 transition.
